gloss: to tremble; to quiver; to shudder

definitions.gloss: to tremble; to quiver; to shudder
definitions.explanation: To shake involuntarily from fear, cold, or strong emotion. Often literary or dramatic.

examples.japanese: {恐怖|きょうふ}におののいた。
{寒|さむ}さにおののきながら{暖|あたた}かい{場所|ばしょ}を{探|さが}した。
examples.english: Shivering from the cold, I looked for a warm place.

examples.japanese: {村人|むらびと}たちは{魔物|まもの}の{出現|しゅつげん}におののいた。
examples.english: The villagers trembled at the appearance of the monster.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}). No pair verb.

KANJI:
Can be written as {戦|おのの}く, which shares the kanji with {戦|たたか}う (to fight), emphasizing the physical shaking.

USAGE:
おののく has a somewhat literary or dramatic quality. It's often used in written narratives, historical texts, or dramatic descriptions. In everyday speech, {震|ふる}える is more common.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{恐怖|きょうふ}におののく (to tremble with fear)
・{寒|さむ}さにおののく (to shiver from cold)
・おののきながら (while trembling)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{震|ふる}える - to tremble/shake (neutral, common)
・がたがた{震|ふる}える - to shiver (onomatopoeic, more vivid)
・{身震|みぶる}いする - to shudder (often from cold or revulsion)
・ぞっとする - to shudder (from horror or disgust)
